description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `parseQuery(query: string): Record<string, string | string[]>` koja pretvara query string u objekat.

- vodeći `?` se ignoriše
- prazan string daje `{}`
- ključ koji se ponavlja daje niz vrednosti
- `%20` i `+` se dekodiraju u razmak (`decodeURIComponent`)
- ključ bez `=` ima praznu vrednost

Primer: `parseQuery('?a=1&b=2&a=3')` → `{ a: ['1', '3'], b: '2' }`
description.en:
Write a function `parseQuery(query: string): Record<string, string | string[]>` that turns a query string into an object.

- a leading `?` is ignored
- an empty string gives `{}`
- a repeated key gives an array of values
- `%20` and `+` are decoded to a space (`decodeURIComponent`)
- a key without `=` has an empty value

Example: `parseQuery('?a=1&b=2&a=3')` → `{ a: ['1', '3'], b: '2' }`

text.sr:
Potpis funkcije.

- `function parseQuery` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom; test je poziva baš tako.
- `query: string` je parametar sa tipom: ulaz je string, npr. `'?a=1&b=2'`.
- `: Record<string, string | string[]>` je tip rezultata: objekat čiji su ključevi stringovi, a vrednosti string ILI niz stringova (kad se ključ ponavlja). `string[]` je niz stringova.
- Tipovi postoje samo dok se kod piše i proverava. Pri izvršavanju se brišu, pa u JavaScript-u ostaje običan kod bez njih.
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 19.
text.en:
The function signature.

- `function parseQuery` creates a function with that name; the test calls it exactly like this.
- `query: string` is a parameter with a type: the input is a string, e.g. `'?a=1&b=2'`.
- `: Record<string, string | string[]>` is the result type: an object whose keys are strings and whose values are a string OR an array of strings (when a key repeats). `string[]` is an array of strings.
- Types exist only while the code is written and checked. They are erased at runtime, so plain code without them remains in JavaScript.
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 19.

text.sr:
Pravimo prazan objekat u koji upisujemo rezultat.

- `const result` pravi promenljivu koja se ne dodeljuje ponovo; `{}` je prazan objekat.
- Tip posle dvotačke se mora izričito navesti: bez njega bi TypeScript zaključio `{}`, pa bi upis `result[key] = ...` bio greška.
- Napomena: za ključ `__proto__` običan objekat ima poseban smisao. U ozbiljnom kodu bi se koristio `Map` ili `Object.create(null)`.
text.en:
We create an empty object into which we write the result.

- `const result` creates a variable that is not reassigned; `{}` is an empty object.
- The type after the colon has to be stated explicitly: without it TypeScript would infer `{}`, and writing `result[key] = ...` would be an error.
- Note: for the key `__proto__` a plain object has a special meaning. In serious code you would use a `Map` or `Object.create(null)`.

text.sr:
Uklanjamo vodeći `?`, ako ga ima.

- `uslov ? a : b` je ternarni operator: uslov, vrednost ako je tačan, vrednost ako nije.
- `query.startsWith('?')` proverava da li string počinje upitnikom.
- `query.slice(1)` vraća string bez prvog znaka. Stringovi su nepromenljivi, pa `query` ostaje isti, a mi dobijamo novi string.
- `?` u uslovu je deo ternarnog operatora, a `'?'` u navodnicima je samo znak koji tražimo.

```
query = '?a=1'  → počinje sa '?' → text = 'a=1'
query = 'a=1'   → ne počinje        → text = 'a=1'
```
text.en:
We remove the leading `?`, if there is one.

- `condition ? a : b` is the ternary operator: a condition, a value if it is true, a value if it is not.
- `query.startsWith('?')` checks whether the string starts with a question mark.
- `query.slice(1)` returns the string without its first character. Strings are immutable, so `query` stays the same and we get a new string.
- The `?` in the condition is part of the ternary operator, while `'?'` in quotes is just the character we are looking for.

```
query = '?a=1'  → starts with '?' → text = 'a=1'
query = 'a=1'   → does not        → text = 'a=1'
```

text.sr:
Rani izlaz za prazan ulaz.

- `!text` je tačno za prazan string (i za ulaz `'?'`, koji je posle uklanjanja upitnika prazan).
- `return result` odmah vraća prazan objekat `{}`.
- Bez ovoga bi `''.split('&')` vratio `['']`, pa bismo dobili jedan ključ sa praznim imenom.
text.en:
An early exit for empty input.

- `!text` is true for an empty string (and for the input `'?'`, which is empty after removing the question mark).
- `return result` immediately returns the empty object `{}`.
- Without this, `''.split('&')` would return `['']`, and we would get one key with an empty name.

text.sr:
Pomoćna funkcija za dekodiranje.

- `const decode = (s: string) => ...` pravi strelica funkciju sa parametrom `s` (string) i čuva je u promenljivoj `decode`.
- `s.replace(/\+/g, ' ')` zamenjuje svaki `+` razmakom: u query stringu `+` znači razmak. Regularni izraz `\+` je bukvalni plus (u regexu je `+` poseban znak, pa se „escape-uje“ kosom crtom), a `g` znači „sve pojave“, ne samo prvu.
- `decodeURIComponent(...)` pretvara `%20` u razmak, a `%C5%A1` u `š`.
- Redosled je bitan: prvo se menja `+`, pa tek onda dekodira. Obrnuto bi `%2B` (kodiran plus) prvo postao `+`, a zatim razmak, što je pogrešno.
- Funkcija baca `URIError` za neispravan niz (npr. `%E0%A4%A`). Ovo rešenje to ne hvata.

```
decode('hello%20world') → 'hello world'
decode('a+b')          → 'a b'
decode('a%2Bb')        → 'a+b'   (kodiran plus ostaje plus)
```
text.en:
A helper function for decoding.

- `const decode = (s: string) => ...` creates an arrow function with the parameter `s` (a string) and keeps it in the variable `decode`.
- `s.replace(/\+/g, ' ')` replaces every `+` with a space: in a query string `+` means a space. The regular expression `\+` is a literal plus (in a regex `+` is a special character, so it is “escaped” with a backslash), and `g` means “all occurrences”, not just the first.
- `decodeURIComponent(...)` turns `%20` into a space, and `%C5%A1` into `š`.
- The order matters: first `+` is replaced, and only then decoded. The other way round, `%2B` (an encoded plus) would first become `+` and then a space, which is wrong.
- The function throws a `URIError` for an invalid string (e.g. `%E0%A4%A`). This solution does not catch that.

```
decode('hello%20world') → 'hello world'
decode('a+b')          → 'a b'
decode('a%2Bb')        → 'a+b'   (an encoded plus stays a plus)
```

text.sr:
Petlja po parovima.

- `text.split('&')` seče string na parove oblika `ključ=vrednost`. Za `'a=1&b=2'` to je `['a=1', 'b=2']`.
- `for (const pair of ...)` uzima jedan po jedan par; u `pair` je trenutni par.
- `{` otvara telo; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 17.
text.en:
A loop over the pairs.

- `text.split('&')` cuts the string into pairs of the form `key=value`. For `'a=1&b=2'` that is `['a=1', 'b=2']`.
- `for (const pair of ...)` takes the pairs one by one; `pair` is the current pair.
- `{` opens the body; it is closed by `}` on line 17.

text.sr:
Tražimo gde je `=`.

- `pair.indexOf('=')` vraća poziciju PRVOG znaka `=` (brojanje od nule), ili `-1` ako ga nema.

```
'a=1'.indexOf('=')   → 1
'flag'.indexOf('=')  → -1
'eq=a=b'.indexOf('=') → 2   (prvi znak =)
```
text.en:
We look for where the `=` is.

- `pair.indexOf('=')` returns the position of the FIRST `=` character (counting from zero), or `-1` if there is none.

```
'a=1'.indexOf('=')   → 1
'flag'.indexOf('=')  → -1
'eq=a=b'.indexOf('=') → 2   (the first =)
```

text.sr:
Izdvajamo ključ.

- Ako nema `=` (`i < 0`), ceo `pair` je ključ (npr. `flag`).
- Inače je ključ deo pre `=`: `pair.slice(0, i)` uzima od početka do pozicije `i`, bez nje.
- Rezultat se dekodira funkcijom `decode`.
text.en:
We extract the key.

- If there is no `=` (`i < 0`), the whole `pair` is the key (e.g. `flag`).
- Otherwise the key is the part before `=`: `pair.slice(0, i)` takes from the start up to position `i`, excluding it.
- The result is decoded with the function `decode`.

text.sr:
Izdvajamo vrednost.

- Bez `=` vrednost je prazan string (`''`).
- Inače je to sve posle PRVOG `=`: `pair.slice(i + 1)`. Zato `eq=a=b` daje vrednost `a=b`, a ne samo `a` (skriveni test). Da smo koristili `pair.split('=')`, vrednost bi bila presečena.

```
'a=1'     → key = 'a',    value = '1'
'flag'    → key = 'flag', value = ''
'eq=a=b'  → key = 'eq',   value = 'a=b'
```
text.en:
We extract the value.

- Without `=` the value is an empty string (`''`).
- Otherwise it is everything after the FIRST `=`: `pair.slice(i + 1)`. That is why `eq=a=b` gives the value `a=b`, not just `a` (hidden test). If we had used `pair.split('=')`, the value would be cut off.

```
'a=1'     → key = 'a',    value = '1'
'flag'    → key = 'flag', value = ''
'eq=a=b'  → key = 'eq',   value = 'a=b'
```

text.sr:
Gledamo šta je već upisano za taj ključ.

- `result[key]` je `undefined` ako ključ još nije viđen.
- Tip je `string | string[] | undefined`: može biti običan string (jedna vrednost), niz stringova (više vrednosti) ili ništa.
text.en:
We look at what is already stored for that key.

- `result[key]` is `undefined` if the key has not been seen yet.
- The type is `string | string[] | undefined`: it can be a plain string (one value), an array of strings (several values) or nothing.

text.sr:
Prvo pojavljivanje ključa: upisujemo običan string.

- `existing === undefined` znači da ključ do sada nije postojao.
- `result[key] = value` upisuje vrednost kao običan string.
text.en:
The first occurrence of the key: we store a plain string.

- `existing === undefined` means the key did not exist so far.
- `result[key] = value` stores the value as a plain string.

text.sr:
Treće i svako sledeće pojavljivanje: već je niz.

- `Array.isArray(existing)` proverava da li je vrednost niz. Ne koristi se `typeof`, jer je `typeof` niza `'object'`. TypeScript posle te provere zna da je `existing` tipa `string[]`.
- `existing.push(value)` dodaje vrednost u postojeći niz (menja ga na mestu).
text.en:
The third and every following occurrence: it is already an array.

- `Array.isArray(existing)` checks whether the value is an array. `typeof` is not used, because the `typeof` of an array is `'object'`. After this check TypeScript knows `existing` is of type `string[]`.
- `existing.push(value)` adds the value to the existing array (modifying it in place).

text.sr:
Drugo pojavljivanje: pretvaramo string u niz od dva elementa.

- Do sada je bio običan string, a sada je `[prethodna, nova]`.
- Ovde TypeScript zna da je `existing` tipa `string` (jer nije `undefined` i nije niz).

Tok za `'t=a&t=b&t=c'`:

```
pair 't=a' → existing je undefined → result.t = 'a'
pair 't=b' → existing je 'a' (string) → result.t = ['a', 'b']
pair 't=c' → existing je niz           → push('c') → ['a', 'b', 'c']
```
text.en:
The second occurrence: we turn the string into an array of two elements.

- Until now it was a plain string, and now it is `[previous, new]`.
- Here TypeScript knows `existing` is of type `string` (since it is neither `undefined` nor an array).

Flow for `'t=a&t=b&t=c'`:

```
pair 't=a' → existing is undefined → result.t = 'a'
pair 't=b' → existing is 'a' (a string) → result.t = ['a', 'b']
pair 't=c' → existing is an array        → push('c') → ['a', 'b', 'c']
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 8.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 8.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Vraćamo popunjen objekat.

- `return result` šalje rezultat pozivaocu i završava funkciju.
text.en:
We return the filled object.

- `return result` sends the result to the caller and ends the function.

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Deli se po prvom `=` (`indexOf`), a ne `split('=')`, da vrednost koja sadrži `=` ostane cela.
note.en: It splits on the first `=` (`indexOf`) rather than `split('=')`, so a value containing `=` stays intact.
